services.title: Ecosystem Services & Core Features
services.question: What are Brainly Core, Speech, and custom integrations?
services.answer: BrainlyHQ services feature an advanced ecosystem of automated bots and real-time synchronization tools. Brainly Core handles automated moderation and identity verification, Brainly Speech translates Slack workspace communications in real time, and dedicated integrations connect multi-server networks and educational platforms.

technology.title: Advanced AI & Real-Time Synapse
technology.question: How do AI moderation models and sync arrays operate?
technology.answer: Our AI algorithms analyze conversation context in real time with an average bot response latency of 26ms. Sync arrays instantly route user profiles, roles, and permissions across connected guilds and platforms.

research.title: Multi-Guild Solutions & Scaling
research.question: How do we solve community scaling and verification challenges?
research.answer: Processing over 400,000 messages seamlessly eliminates the overhead of managing multiple servers simultaneously. Our dedicated verification framework and multi-guild architecture allow you to securely scale communities with tens of thousands of members.
